knownDefect.summary: An empty result is rendered as a table header with no rows, unlike the soft "no results" sentence the other 22 tools use. A model reads a well-formed empty table as a real answer. Annotated, not pinned: when this is changed to a soft-empty sentence the probe stops holding and the case is re-pinned.
